# Task prompt

## Mode
read-only | plan | implement | review | handoff

## Goal
One concrete outcome.

## Read first
AGENTS, HANDOFF, selected task evidence and applicable decisions.

## Scope + file budget
Allowed files/modules and an exact file budget; revise before expanding.
Reuse check: name the existing registries/helpers from [FEATURE_MAP](../FEATURE_MAP.md)
that cover this feature; justify any new mechanism before rebuilding one.

## Out of scope
Explicit exclusions and protected files.

## Pending closures to record first
Merged tasks with owner evidence received; record in the first commit.

## Acceptance criteria
Observable results and each task's done_when.

## Verification
Required commands and evidence limits; label every QA item
Verified / Inferred / Not run (reason).

## STOP conditions
Unclear authority, blocked access, secrets or changes outside scope.

## Report
Arabic S-STD-1 order 1–8 and both AGENTS questions; at most150 lines.
Link detail and consolidate all owner decisions into one list.
